Name: Craftable Feed Hopper
Author: inmognito
Description:
A simple little mod to make the feed hopper craftable for fifty wood and ten hay, and useable outside of barns and coops.

You learn the crafting recipe at Farming level 2.

This means y﻿ou can remove hay from silos
[list]
[*]when all feed spots are fully stocked
[*]when all barns and coops are fully upgraded
[/list]
[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Download the file
[*]Extract the Zip
[*]Place in your Mods folder
[/list]
[b]Compatibility
[/b][list]
[*]Everything, unless they also change the functioning of the Feed Hopper
[/list]
